home.title: Where artists stand
home.intro: Public positions of Ukrainian, Russian, and regional musicians on Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine — documented, dated, and sourced.

ua_vocal.label: Pro-Ukraine

ambiguous.desc: Evasive or contradictory: "against all war" without naming the aggressor.

ru_leaning.desc: Continues a Russian state-adjacent career while staying silent on the war.

about.title: About & methodology
about.intro1: Pozytsiya tracks where popular musicians stand on Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. It covers Ukrainian and Russian artists, artists from the wider region whose audiences span both countries, and international artists whose statements and actions on the war are documented.
about.intro2: Every entry is based on public statements and documented actions. Nothing here is inferred from silence alone: an artist with no known position is listed as silent, not assigned a side.
about.scaleIntro: Positions sit on a seven-point spectrum, assigned only when supported by documented statements or actions. Two off-scale statuses cover everyone else.
about.flagsIntro: Badges mark documented facts that don't fit on the spectrum: sanctions, bans, emigration, military service, and similar.
about.sourcingBody: Each timeline entry links to at least one dated source. We prefer artists' own statements and reporting from established outlets; Russian state media is labeled as such. Descriptions state facts and dates without editorializing. Where reliable accounts genuinely conflict, the entry is marked as disputed.
about.correctionsBody: See something wrong or outdated? Corrections are welcome as issues or pull requests on the project's GitHub — corrections that come with sources are applied fastest.
